mapper.sql: p.profile_id AS profileId, p.user_id AS userId, u.nickname, u.email, p.display_name AS displayName, p.short_intro AS shortIntro, p.detail_intro AS detailIntro, CASE WHEN p.profile_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/profile/', p.profile_id) ELSE NULL END AS profileImageUrl, p.visibility, p.activity_status AS activityStatus, p.region_id AS regionId, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, rg.sido_name AS sidoName, rg.sigungu_name AS sigunguName, rg.dong_name AS dongName, rg.center_lat AS centerLat, rg.center_lng AS centerLng, p.experience_level AS experienceLevel, p.join_availability AS joinAvailability, p.collaboration_status AS collaborationStatus, p.travel_range AS travelRange, p.preferred_duration AS preferredDuration, p.profile_completed_yn AS profileCompletedYn, p.status AS profileStatus, p.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt

t.team_id AS teamId, t.leader_user_id AS leaderUserId, leader.nickname AS leaderNickname, t.name, t.description, CASE WHEN t.representative_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/team/', t.team_id) ELSE NULL END AS imageUrl, t.status, t.region_id AS regionId, t.region_any_yn AS regionAnyYn, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, rg.sido_name AS sidoName, rg.sigungu_name AS sigunguName, rg.center_lat AS centerLat, rg.center_lng AS centerLng, t.expected_duration AS expectedDuration, t.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, t.current_member_count AS currentMemberCount, t.last_active_at AS lastActiveAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM member_profile p JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM member_profile p JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.profile_id = #{profileId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, rc.role_category_id AS roleCategoryId, rc.name AS roleCategoryName FROM profile_role pr JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = pr.role_id JOIN role_category rc ON rc.role_category_id = r.role_category_id WHERE pr.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY rc.sort_order, r.sort_order
SELECT g.genre_id AS genreId, g.name FROM profile_genre pg JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = pg.genre_id WHERE pg.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY g.sort_order

SELECT pcc.condition_code AS conditionCode, COALESCE(c.display_name, pcc.condition_code) AS displayName FROM profile_collaboration_condition pcc LEFT JOIN common_code c ON c.code_group = 'COLLABORATION_CONDITION' AND c.code = pcc.condition_code WHERE pcc.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY c.sort_order, pcc.condition_code
SELECT FROM team t JOIN user_account leader ON leader.user_id = t.leader_user_id LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = t.region_id WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId} AND t.status != 'DELETED'
SELECT g.genre_id AS genreId, g.name FROM team_genre tg JOIN genre g ON g.genre_id = tg.genre_id WHERE tg.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY g.sort_order

SELECT s.slot_id AS slotId, s.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.team_id AS teamId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, tr.status AS recruitmentStatus, tr.work_start_at AS workStartAt, s.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, s.required_count AS requiredCount, s.accepted_count AS acceptedCount, s.required_count - s.accepted_count AS remainingCount, s.required_experience_level AS requiredExperienceLevel, s.collaboration_condition AS collaborationCondition, s.role_duration AS roleDuration, s.status AS slotStatus FROM team_recruitment_slot s JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = s.recruitment_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id WHERE s.slot_id = #{slotId} AND s.status != 'DELETED' AND tr.status != 'DELETED'

SELECT ,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_follow uf WHERE uf.follower_user_id = #{currentUserId} AND uf.following_user_id = p.user_id )
FALSE AS followingByCurrentUser,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_invitation ti WHERE ti.team_id = #{teamId} AND ti.slot_id = #{slotId} AND ti.target_user_id = p.user_id AND ti.status = 'PENDING' )
FALSE AS invitedByCurrentUser,
( SELECT ti.invitation_id FROM team_invitation ti WHERE ti.team_id = #{teamId} AND ti.slot_id = #{slotId} AND ti.target_user_id = p.user_id AND ti.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY ti.created_at DESC, ti.invitation_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
NULL AS invitationId FROM member_profile p JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = p.user_id JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.profile_completed_yn = 'Y' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.activity_status = 'VISIBLE' AND p.visibility IN ('PUBLIC', 'COMPANY') AND u.account_status = 'ACTIVE'
AND p.user_id != #{currentUserId}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} AND tm.user_id = p.user_id AND tm.status = 'ACTIVE' )
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.profile_id DESC

SELECT pi.portfolio_item_id AS portfolioItemId, pi.profile_id AS profileId, pi.public_data_sync_item_id AS publicDataSyncItemId, pi.title, pi.role_name AS roleName, pi.credit_name AS creditName, pi.description, pi.source_type AS sourceType, pi.external_source_name AS externalSourceName, pi.external_reference_id AS externalReferenceId, pi.url, pi.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, CASE WHEN pi.thumbnail_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/portfolio/', pi.portfolio_item_id) ELSE NULL END AS uploadedThumbnailUrl, pi.sort_order AS sortOrder, pi.status, pi.created_at AS createdAt, pi.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN pv.verification_status = 'VERIFIED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS verified, pv.provider AS verificationProvider, pv.provider_movie_title AS providerMovieTitle, pv.provider_movie_title_en AS providerMovieTitleEn, pv.provider_movie_year AS providerMovieYear, pv.provider_open_date AS providerOpenDate, pv.provider_genres AS providerGenres, pv.provider_person_name AS providerPersonName, pv.provider_role_name AS providerRoleName, pv.provider_role_name AS matchedRoleName, pv.matched_role_group AS matchedRoleGroup, pv.matched_source AS matchedSource FROM portfolio_item pi LEFT JOIN portfolio_verification pv ON pv.portfolio_item_id = pi.portfolio_item_id WHERE pi.profile_id = #{profileId} AND pi.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.created_at DESC

SELECT t.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, t.description AS teamDescription, CASE WHEN t.representative_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/team/', t.team_id) ELSE NULL END AS imageUrl, t.status AS teamStatus, t.region_id AS regionId, t.region_any_yn AS regionAnyYn, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, rg.sido_name AS sidoName, rg.sigungu_name AS sigunguName, rg.center_lat AS centerLat, rg.center_lng AS centerLng, t.expected_duration AS expectedDuration, t.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, t.current_member_count AS currentMemberCount, tr.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, tr.deadline_at AS deadlineAt, tr.work_start_at AS workStartAt, s.slot_id AS slotId, s.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, s.required_count AS requiredCount, s.accepted_count AS acceptedCount, s.required_count - s.accepted_count AS remainingCount, s.required_experience_level AS requiredExperienceLevel, s.collaboration_condition AS collaborationCondition, s.role_duration AS roleDuration, s.status AS slotStatus,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM matching_bookmark mb WHERE mb.user_id = #{userId} AND mb.target_type = 'TEAM' AND mb.target_id = t.team_id )
FALSE AS savedByCurrentUser,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_application ta WHERE ta.team_id = t.team_id AND ta.slot_id = s.slot_id AND ta.applicant_user_id = #{userId} AND ta.status = 'PENDING' )
FALSE AS appliedByCurrentUser,
( SELECT ta.application_id FROM team_application ta WHERE ta.team_id = t.team_id AND ta.slot_id = s.slot_id AND ta.applicant_user_id = #{userId} AND ta.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY ta.created_at DESC, ta.application_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
NULL AS applicationId FROM team_recruitment_slot s JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = s.recruitment_id JOIN team t ON t.team_id = tr.team_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = t.region_id WHERE t.status IN ('RECRUITING', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND tr.status = 'OPEN' AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND s.required_count > s.accepted_count ORDER BY tr.created_at DESC, s.slot_id

SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_name AS policyName, status, version, description, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM matching_score_policy WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY version DESC, policy_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT policy_item_id AS policyItemId, policy_id AS policyId, score_group AS scoreGroup, element_code AS elementCode, display_name AS displayName, weight, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM matching_score_policy_item WHERE policy_id = #{policyId} AND active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY score_group, sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO matching_bookmark (user_id, target_type, target_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT mb.bookmark_id AS bookmarkId, mb.created_at AS savedAt, t.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, t.description AS teamDescription, t.status AS teamStatus, t.region_id AS regionId, t.region_any_yn AS regionAnyYn, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, t.expected_duration AS expectedDuration, t.max_member_count AS maxMemberCount, t.current_member_count AS currentMemberCount FROM matching_bookmark mb JOIN team t ON t.team_id = mb.target_id LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = t.region_id WHERE mb.user_id = #{userId} AND mb.target_type = 'TEAM' ORDER BY mb.created_at DESC, mb.bookmark_id DESC

SELECT tr.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, tr.deadline_at AS deadlineAt, tr.work_start_at AS workStartAt, s.slot_id AS slotId, s.role_id AS roleId, r.name AS roleName, s.required_count AS requiredCount, s.accepted_count AS acceptedCount, s.required_count - s.accepted_count AS remainingCount, s.required_experience_level AS requiredExperienceLevel, s.collaboration_condition AS collaborationCondition, s.role_duration AS roleDuration,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_application ta WHERE ta.team_id = t.team_id AND ta.slot_id = s.slot_id AND ta.applicant_user_id = #{userId} AND ta.status = 'PENDING' )
FALSE AS appliedByCurrentUser,
( SELECT ta.application_id FROM team_application ta WHERE ta.team_id = t.team_id AND ta.slot_id = s.slot_id AND ta.applicant_user_id = #{userId} AND ta.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY ta.created_at DESC, ta.application_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
NULL AS applicationId FROM team_recruitment_slot s JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = s.recruitment_id JOIN team t ON t.team_id = tr.team_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId} AND t.status IN ('RECRUITING', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND tr.status = 'OPEN' AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND s.required_count > s.accepted_count ORDER BY tr.created_at DESC, s.slot_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_invitation (team_id, recruitment_id, slot_id, target_user_id, inviter_user_id, message, status, created_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{recruitmentId}, #{slotId}, #{targetUserId}, #{inviterUserId}, #{message}, 'PENDING', NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE invitation_id = invitation_id
mapper.select: SELECT ti.invitation_id AS invitationId, ti.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, ti.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, ti.slot_id AS slotId, r.name AS roleName, ti.target_user_id AS targetUserId, target.nickname AS targetNickname, mp.profile_id AS targetProfileId, mp.display_name AS targetDisplayName, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, ti.inviter_user_id AS inviterUserId, ti.message, ti.status, ti.created_at AS createdAt FROM team_invitation ti JOIN team t ON t.team_id = ti.team_id JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = ti.recruitment_id JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.slot_id = ti.slot_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id JOIN user_account target ON target.user_id = ti.target_user_id LEFT JOIN member_profile mp ON mp.user_id = ti.target_user_id AND mp.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = mp.region_id WHERE ti.team_id = #{teamId} AND ti.slot_id = #{slotId} AND ti.target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND ti.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY ti.created_at DESC, ti.invitation_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ti.invitation_id AS invitationId, ti.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, ti.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, ti.slot_id AS slotId, r.name AS roleName, ti.target_user_id AS targetUserId, target.nickname AS targetNickname, mp.profile_id AS targetProfileId, mp.display_name AS targetDisplayName, CASE WHEN mp.profile_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/profile/', mp.profile_id) ELSE NULL END AS profileImageUrl, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, ti.message, ti.status, ti.decided_at AS decidedAt, ti.created_at AS createdAt FROM team_invitation ti JOIN team t ON t.team_id = ti.team_id JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = ti.recruitment_id JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.slot_id = ti.slot_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id JOIN user_account target ON target.user_id = ti.target_user_id LEFT JOIN member_profile mp ON mp.user_id = ti.target_user_id AND mp.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = mp.region_id WHERE ti.inviter_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY FIELD(ti.status, 'PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED'), ti.created_at DESC

SELECT invitation_id AS invitationId, team_id AS teamId, recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, slot_id AS slotId, target_user_id AS targetUserId, inviter_user_id AS inviterUserId, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM team_invitation WHERE invitation_id = #{invitationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE team_invitation SET status = 'CANCELED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE invitation_id = #{invitationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_application (team_id, recruitment_id, slot_id, applicant_user_id, message, status, created_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{recruitmentId}, #{slotId}, #{applicantUserId}, #{message}, 'PENDING', NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE application_id = application_id
mapper.select: SELECT ta.application_id AS applicationId, ta.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, t.description AS teamDescription, ta.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, ta.slot_id AS slotId, r.name AS roleName, ta.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, ta.message, ta.status, ta.created_at AS createdAt FROM team_application ta JOIN team t ON t.team_id = ta.team_id JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = ta.recruitment_id JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.slot_id = ta.slot_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id WHERE ta.team_id = #{teamId} AND ta.slot_id = #{slotId} AND ta.applicant_user_id = #{applicantUserId} AND ta.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY ta.created_at DESC, ta.application_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ta.application_id AS applicationId, ta.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, t.description AS teamDescription, CASE WHEN t.representative_image_path IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/api/media/images/team/', t.team_id) ELSE NULL END AS imageUrl, t.status AS teamStatus, t.region_any_yn AS regionAnyYn, rg.public_display_name AS publicRegionName, ta.recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, tr.title AS recruitmentTitle, ta.slot_id AS slotId, r.name AS roleName, ta.message, ta.status, ta.reject_reason AS rejectReason, ta.decided_at AS decidedAt, ta.created_at AS createdAt FROM team_application ta JOIN team t ON t.team_id = ta.team_id JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tr.recruitment_id = ta.recruitment_id JOIN team_recruitment_slot s ON s.slot_id = ta.slot_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id = s.role_id LEFT JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = t.region_id WHERE ta.applicant_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY FIELD(ta.status, 'PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELED', 'EXPIRED'), ta.created_at DESC

SELECT application_id AS applicationId, team_id AS teamId, recruitment_id AS recruitmentId, slot_id AS slotId, applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM team_application WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE team_application SET status = 'CANCELED', reject_reason = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO matching_action_log (actor_user_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, team_id, role_id, created_at) VALUES (#{actorUserId}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{teamId}, #{roleId}, NOW())
